Both grades of Coal Thumper and Charcoal Kilns gain one insulation level.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Coal Thumper.

technologies.title: Coal Storage Compactors
technologies.description:
Both sizes of Resource Depot gain a 65% capacity bonus for coal.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Resource Depot Upgrade.

technologies.title: Care House Thermal Liners
technologies.description:
Care Houses and Houses of Healing gain one insulation level.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I).

technologies.title: Machine Shop Safety Screens
technologies.description:
Machine Shops and Foundries gain one safety level.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Machine Shop.

technologies.title: Port Coal Compactors
technologies.description:
Both sizes of Resource Depot gain a 65% capacity bonus for coal.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Resource Depot Upgrade.

technologies.title: Fuel Crew Workwear
technologies.description:
Charcoal Kilns and Gathering Posts gain one insulation level.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I).

technologies.title: Steelworks Refractory Linings
technologies.description:
All three grades of Steelworks gain one insulation level.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Steelworks.

technologies.title: Ingot Storage Cradles
technologies.description:
Both sizes of Resource Depot gain an 80% capacity bonus for steel.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I).

technologies.title: Steelworks Shift Teams
technologies.description:
Human crews and automatons gain a 75% workplace efficiency bonus at every grade of Steelworks.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators (III), Steelworks.

technologies.title: Continuous Casting
technologies.description:
All three grades of Steelworks gain a further 45% steel production bonus.

Requires: Difference Engine (IV), Steelworks Shift Teams.

technologies.title: Salvage Sorting Stations
technologies.description:
Gathering Posts collect resources 75% faster.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Gang Saw Blades
technologies.description:
Both grades of Sawmill gain a 75% wood production bonus.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Steelworks Charge Bins
technologies.description:
All three grades of Steelworks gain a 75% steel production bonus.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Generator Draft Grates
technologies.description:
The Generator burns 20% less coal.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Steam Hub Flow Valves
technologies.description:
Steam Hubs burn 20% less coal.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Hunter Trail Caches
technologies.description:
Hunters' Huts bring home 4 extra raw food per hunt at full staffing.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Insulated Sick Wards
technologies.description:
Medical Posts, Infirmaries, and Care Houses gain one insulation level.

Requires: No prior research.

Requires: No prior research.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Harbour Tidal Charts
technologies.description:
Both grades of Fishing Harbour gain a 75% fishing efficiency bonus.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Fabrication Safety Walkways
technologies.description:
Profiles Manufacture buildings, Machine Shops, and Foundries gain one safety level.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Gathering Sled Networks
technologies.description:
Gathering Posts gain a 50% collection radius bonus, letting each post reach more resource piles.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I).

technologies.title: Gathering Sled Networks
technologies.description:
Gathering Posts gain a 50% collection radius bonus, letting each post reach more resource piles.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I).

technologies.title: Modular Hothouse Core Mounts
technologies.description:
Both grades of Hothouse cost one fewer Steam Core to build. A standard Hothouse can be built without a core, and an Industrial Hothouse needs one core.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Hothouse.

technologies.title: Modular Extraction Cassettes
technologies.description:
All grades of Coal Mine and Wall Drill cost one fewer Steam Core to build. Basic Coal Mines and Wall Drills can be built without a core.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators (III), Coal Mining.

technologies.title: Crane Arrestor Brakes
technologies.description:
All three grades of Reloading Station gain one safety level, offsetting the extra danger of upgraded machinery.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Reloading Station.

technologies.title: Conservative Surgical Protocols
technologies.description:
Medical Posts reduce the amputation risk of Radical Treatment by 75%. This gives Radical Treatment a safer long-term role in cities with few Infirmaries. The Radical Treatment law must be active for this effect to matter.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Medical Post Upgrade.

technologies.title: Storm Duty Clothing
technologies.description:
Citizens have a 50% lower chance of illness caused by low temperatures. This helps sustain outdoor and dispersed workplaces during cold weather.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II).

technologies.title: Prefab Assembly Teams
technologies.description:
Building construction takes 75% less time. Construction crews finish new sites four times as quickly, making it easier to relocate production as deposits run out or the weather changes.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I).

technologies.title: District Steam Trunklines
technologies.description:
All heat zones gain 50% more radius, including the Generator, Steam Hubs, and Braziers where present. Wider coverage allows districts to spread farther from each heat source.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators (III), Steam Hub.

technologies.title: Brazier District Networks
technologies.description:
All heat zones gain 50% more radius, including the Generator, Steam Hubs, and Braziers where present. Wider coverage allows districts to spread farther from each heat source.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators (III), Braziers.

technologies.title: Outpost Network Charters
technologies.description:
Each Outpost Depot can dispatch two additional Outpost teams, supporting up to three Outposts per depot. This enables a city that imports more of its basic supplies.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators (III), Outpost Depot.

technologies.title: Forager Supply Web
technologies.description:
Allows two additional Foragers' Quarters and forager teams, expanding the food supply that can be gathered outside the city.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators (III), Extra Forager Crew.

technologies.title: Scrap Recovery Contracts
technologies.description:
Unlocks a Factory queue for salvaging frozen scrap. Spend 12 wood and 30 coal to recover 10 steel in 5 working hours.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Factory.

technologies.title: Deep Scrap Recovery
technologies.description:
Replaces the Factory salvage batch. Spend 8 wood and 26 coal to recover 14 steel in 5 working hours.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators (III), Scrap Recovery Contracts.

technologies.title: Fuelled Stockpots
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Cookhouse recipe. Spend 2 raw food and 1 coal to cook 6 standard rations in 9 minutes at full efficiency.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I).

technologies.title: Retort Kiln Batches
technologies.description:
Unlocks Retort Kiln Batches. Spend 7 wood and 1 steel for 56 coal in 1 working hour at full efficiency. Steel maintains the sealed retorts, saving wood per unit of coal. Select the recipe at a Charcoal Kiln.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Charcoal Kiln.

technologies.title: Coal-Heated Seedbeds
technologies.description:
Unlocks optional Hothouse growing recipes. Spend 2 coal for 4 raw food in 40 working minutes, or 4 coal for 8 raw food in an Industrial Hothouse. Both run at roughly twice the normal base growing rate. Select the recipe at each Hothouse.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Hothouse.

technologies.title: Retort Kiln Batches
technologies.description:
Unlocks Retort Kiln Batches. Spend 7 wood and 1 steel for 56 coal in 1 working hour at full efficiency. Steel maintains the sealed retorts, saving wood per unit of coal. Select the recipe at a Charcoal Kiln.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Charcoal Kiln.

technologies.title: Baited Deep-Water Nets
technologies.description:
Unlocks optional Fishing Harbour recipes. Spend 1 food ration and 1 coal for 5 raw food in 45 working minutes, or 8 raw food at an Advanced Fishing Harbour. Select the recipe at each harbour.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Fishing Harbour.

technologies.title: Steam-Cured Profiles
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Profiles Manufacture recipe. Spend 12 wood and 15 coal for 1 structural profile in 1.25 working hours at full efficiency. Select it in the building panel.

Requires: Profiles Manufacture.

technologies.title: Fuel-Tempered Exchangers
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Machine Shop recipe. Spend 12 steel and 20 coal for 1 steam exchanger in 2 working hours at full efficiency. Select it in the building panel.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Machine Shop.

technologies.title: Charcoal-Alloy Composites
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Foundry recipe. Spend 12 steel and 70 coal for 1 steel composite in 2.5 working hours at full efficiency. Select it in the building panel.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Foundry.

technologies.title: Warehouse Cutting Torches
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Army Warehouse recipe. Spend 10 wood and 20 coal to recover 48 steel in 3 working hours at full efficiency. Select it at the Army Warehouse.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Rapid Coking Beds
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Charcoal Kiln recipe. Spend 14 wood for 56 coal in 30 working minutes at full efficiency. This burns through wood faster to deliver coal quickly when reserves are low.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Charcoal Kiln.

technologies.title: Rapid Coking Beds
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Charcoal Kiln recipe. Spend 14 wood for 56 coal in 30 working minutes at full efficiency. This burns through wood faster to deliver coal quickly when reserves are low.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Charcoal Kiln.

technologies.title: Fermentation Beds
technologies.description:
Unlocks ration-fed Hothouse recipes. A Hothouse spends 1 food ration and 1 coal for 5 raw food in 1 working hour. An Industrial Hothouse spends 2 rations and 2 coal for 10 raw food. These conserve coal compared with Coal-Heated Seedbeds and return rations to the growing cycle as a starter.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Hothouse.

technologies.title: Dockside Smokehouses
technologies.description:
Unlocks direct ration production at Fishing Harbours. Spend 1 wood and 2 coal for 8 standard food rations per working hour, or 12 rations at an Advanced Fishing Harbour. The catch is prepared at the harbour, freeing the Cookhouse crew for other work.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Fishing Harbour.

technologies.title: Research Sprint
technologies.description:
Spend 12 coal and 4 food rations to give the selected Workshop +50% workplace efficiency for 6 hours. Cooldown: 24 hours per building.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Workshop Test Rigs.

technologies.title: Research Sprint
technologies.description:
Spend 12 coal and 4 food rations to give the selected Workshop +50% workplace efficiency for 6 hours. Cooldown: 24 hours per building.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I), Workshop Test Rigs.

technologies.title: Furnace Overfire
technologies.description:
Spend 22 coal to give the selected Steelworks +50% workplace efficiency for 8 hours. Cooldown: 24 hours per building.

Requires: Drafting Machines (II), Steam Steelworks.

technologies.title: Emergency Heat Packs
technologies.description:
Spend 20 coal to give the selected Gathering Post, Cookhouse, or Factory two extra heat levels for 8 hours. Cooldown: 24 hours per building.

Requires: Drawing Boards (I).

technologies.title: Coal Pressure Purge
technologies.description:
Use the Repair Station to spend 45 coal and reduce current Generator stress by 18 percentage points. Cooldown: 24 hours per building.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators (III), Repair Station.
